author: Ingenimind Kft.
name: Skill Suite judging session
description: A complete session module: contracts, reference implementation, hidden graded suite, and self-contained white-box and black-box judge images.

judgeBase.description: Base image the judge images build FROM. Use skill-suite-judge-base:9.0 for a locally built base.

imageTag.description: Immutable tag for the built judge images. Never use a mutable tag: the platform runs docker run with no --pull.

sourceName_comment: No postActions on purpose: a RunScript action would restore the execute bit on the shell scripts, but it makes dotnet new prompt for --allow-scripts and hang in any non-interactive context. The README's first step is a single chmod instead.
